summary: This March 31 Game Theory lecture turns financial collapse into a source-backed mechanism: money is a collective hallucination, interest rates coordinate bank liquidity, and collapse happens when players can profit more from breaking the system than from preserving it.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read marks money as an idea, concept, and collective hallucination created through bank liquidity.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Power As Alchemy already owns the conversion by which invented monetary signs become lived reality; this source gives that mechanism a bank-liquidity classroom version.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Power anchor owns private capture of public distress; this source strengthens it with a financial-crash and Great Reset form.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The official boom-bust story is treated as the visible surface, while the real game is whether the player positioned behind the loan, bet, bank, or capital flow profits from continuation or default.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Game Theory owns the method of asking who the active player is, what payoff is nearer, and which official explanation hides the actual board.

new_lens_seeds.title: Engineered Collapse As Exit Liquidity
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Collapse becomes rational when actors positioned inside the credit, banking, or capital-flow game can leave with money, force others into default, buy distressed assets cheaply, and call the damage renewal.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gives a reusable mechanism that crosses 2008, private credit, AI finance, China handoff, U.S. collapse, Israel routing, and distressed resource acquisition without being reducible to a single market topic.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed and routing test. Promote only after a concept-scoped review proves that Power's monetary alchemy and Game Theory's payoff method cannot carry the mechanism without blurring collapse-as-profit into ordinary money or ordinary strategy.

new_lens_seeds.title: Capital Has No Moral Client
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Transnational capital treats states, banks, wars, and ideologies as hosts for movement and growth; it can serve Nazi Germany, American consumerism, China, Israel, or a distressed-asset buyer because allegiance is subordinate to activity.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The BIS and parasite/host passages could connect Power, Secret Society, Imperial Retrenchment, and Eschatology, but the current public map can still route them by active mechanism.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. Power owns monetary abstraction and capital movement; Secret Society owns hidden coordination technology; Imperial Retrenchment owns successor-center strategy; Eschatology owns sacred role-script convergence.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-03-31, this source is a late Game Theory classroom formulation after the March Iran-war cluster: Jiang ties a predicted U.S. financial collapse to war and reads collapse as engineered rather than spontaneous.

The source gives a genealogy from 1688/1694 Bank of England through the Federal Reserve, 1929, World War II, Cold War, unipolar financialization, and 2008, so later use should preserve the long finance-war chronology rather than treating the Great Reset claim as a current-events slogan.

On 2026-03-31 Jiang explicitly updates the collapse model to private credit and AI as current insider bubbles that can continue while insiders roll losses, but can be broken if collapse becomes the better payoff.

The China-to-Israel sequence should be handled as a dated March 31 projection: China was the attempted post-2008 center of gravity but, in Jiang's framing, refused or could not accept the full hegemonic burden, leaving Israel as the next capital/activity destination.
